decisions.reason: Although it has not been visible on the website since 2020, this illuminated candle arch still builds strongly on the firm's core craft knowledge, so management would keep it while accepting a moderate withdrawal risk if demand has faded.

This one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to the firm's established competence base and can be refreshed through normal design and workshop learning, so it remains worth keeping despite weaker recent visibility.

After several years without visible website presence, the electronically based music box still sits too far from the firm's traditional knowledge base for a low-R&D craft producer to improve and commercialise confidently.
Because this accessory depends on the uncertain electronic music-box platform and is even further from the firm's strongest know-how, management would release resources by taking it off the market.
